method.exactFiles: Complete original bytes are equal; SHA-256 and Git blob IDs are recorded.
method.substantialBlocks: Same-path raw splitlines; SequenceMatcher(autoJunk=False); blocks at least 6 lines and 200 non-newline bytes. No identifiers or branding were normalized.
method.blockHashes: SHA-256 over exact matching lines joined by LF, without trailing LF; original full-file bytes are separately hashed.
method.genericTemplateExclusion: src/vite-env.d.ts is counted separately and excluded from functional exact-file totals.
method.coverage: Tracked product/source files and tracked images/fonts/audio from two immutable local Git trees compared to one immutable public upstream tree.
method.noOriginalityPercentage: Overlap is evidence, not a copyright ownership determination or an originality percentage.
